name: MonarchAiUsageMeter
title: AiUsageMeter
wrapsNative: MonarchUsageMeter (ProgressView with a ProgressViewStyle per item)
summary: How much AI the person has used against their quotas: one meter per scope (this turn, this conversation, this month) in tokens or credits, with a written warning near the limit and over it.
whenToUse: In an assistant panel, settings or billing screen where people need to see how close they are to their AI quotas.
whenNotToUse: For quotas that are not AI tokens or credits (seats, storage, requests) use MonarchUsageMeter. For the cost of one message use the message metadata.
api: MonarchAiUsageMeter.init(_ title: String? = nil, scopes: [MonarchAiUsageScope], period: String? = nil, resetsAt: Date? = nil, warningAt: Double = 0.8, isLoading: Bool = false, error: String? = nil, labels: MonarchAiUsageMeterLabels = MonarchAiUsageMeterLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchAiUsageScope.init(_ label: String, id: String? = nil, used: Double, limit: Double? = nil, unit: MonarchAiUsageUnit = .tokens)
MonarchAiUsageMeterLabels.init(label: String? = nil, unit: (@Sendable (_ unit: MonarchAiUsageUnit, _ count: Double) -> String)? = nil, meter: MonarchUsageMeterLabels = MonarchUsageMeterLabels())

options.name: title
options.description: A visible heading. Without it the group is named "AI usage" for VoiceOver.

options.name: scopes
options.description: The quotas in order, each with a label, the amount used, an optional limit and a unit (tokens or credits).

options.name: period
options.description: The period measured, shown under the title.

options.name: resetsAt
options.description: When the quotas reset, shown under the title.

options.name: warningAt
options.description: The share of a limit at which a scope is near the limit.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows a spinner instead of the scopes.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message shown instead of the scopes.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces the group name, the unit names and the strings of the underlying usage meter.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a retry button under the error.

states.name: normal
states.description: Below the warning share: the meter uses the accent fill and the share in muted text.

states.name: near the limit
states.description: At or above warningAt: warning fill, a warning icon and "Near the limit".

states.name: over the limit
states.description: Above the limit: danger fill, a danger icon and "Over the limit".

states.name: no limit
states.description: The amount alone, with no meter.

states.name: error
states.description: The message with an icon, and a retry button with onRetry.

appearance: The look of MonarchUsageMeter: muted labels, strong figures, a muted track with the accent, warning or danger fill, and warning or danger status text. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: A preset of MonarchUsageMeter, so it also offers a title, a period, a reset date, loading and error, which the web does not. The web calls a scope exceeded when it reaches its limit; the shared iOS meter calls a scope over the limit only above it and near the limit at exactly 100%. The web's number and percent formatters are replaced by the meter's locale-aware formatting. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The meter is a group named by the title, or by "AI usage".
Each scope is one element read as its label, with the figures, the level and the percentage as its value.
Near and over the limit are written and have an icon, so they do not depend on colour.
When a scope reaches near or over the limit while the view is on screen, VoiceOver announces it once.
edgeCases: A negative amount counts as zero; a limit of zero or less is no limit.
Scopes are identified by position unless they have an id, so labels may repeat.
The unit is singular only for exactly one (the limit, or the amount when there is no limit).

examples.title: Turn, conversation and month
examples.template:
MonarchAiUsageMeter(scopes: [
    MonarchAiUsageScope({{scopes.0.label}}, used: {{scopes.0.used|double}}, unit: {{scopes.0.unit|case}}),
    MonarchAiUsageScope({{scopes.1.label}}, used: {{scopes.1.used|double}}, limit: {{scopes.1.limit|double}}, unit: {{scopes.1.unit|case}}),
    MonarchAiUsageScope({{scopes.2.label}}, used: {{scopes.2.used|double}}, limit: {{scopes.2.limit|double}}, unit: {{scopes.2.unit|case}}),
])
examples.code:
MonarchAiUsageMeter(scopes: [
    MonarchAiUsageScope("This turn", used: 1840.0, unit: .tokens),
    MonarchAiUsageScope("Conversation", used: 42_000.0, limit: 200_000.0, unit: .tokens),
    MonarchAiUsageScope("This month", used: 870.0, limit: 1000.0, unit: .credits),
])

examples.title: Titled, with a period
examples.code:
MonarchAiUsageMeter(
    "AI usage",
    scopes: [MonarchAiUsageScope("Image generation", used: 32, limit: 100, unit: .credits)],
    period: "November"
)
